Right-aligned by a style attribute.

A justified paragraph spreads the words of every full line across the whole width, so both edges of the text block line up with the margins.
A line that ends in a break is not stretched, and the text after it is justified again until the paragraph's last line, which keeps its natural spacing.

Justified links stay clickable where their stretched words are drawn on every line of the paragraph.
